name: 发丝一致性分析
algorithm: Hair Strand Consistency — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes hair strand temporal consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **StrandFlow提取**: Oriented texture analysis extracts the dominant hair flow direction across the hair region per frame. Hair strand orientation maps capture the directional structure of the hairstyle.

2. **Flow时间一致性**: Hair strand orientation should change smoothly and coherently across frames — strands move together as connected structures following physical dynamics. The method tracks orientation map consistency. Deepfake generators may produce incoherent inter-frame strand flow, where hair directions shift independently without physical motivation.

3. **Strand运动Physics**: Hair strand motion follows pendulum-like physics with characteristic frequency dependent on strand length and head motion. The method analyzes the frequency content of hair motion signals. AI-generated hair motion may lack correct physical frequencies or show overly smooth motion without natural oscillation.

4. **头发-人脸边界一致性**: At the hair-face boundary, hair strands should maintain consistent spatial relationships with facial landmarks (sideburns align with temples, bangs maintain forehead coverage). Deepfakes may show hair-face boundary instabilities where the independently generated face doesn't maintain proper spatial relationship with the original hair.

5. **StrandRendering一致性**: The rendering quality of hair strands should be spatially and temporally uniform. The method checks for regions where strand quality degrades — AI generators may produce good strand rendering in some areas but degrade in complex regions (wind-blown hair, overlapping layers), creating detectable quality inconsistencies.
parameters:
分析类型: 统计
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through hair strand consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Corvi et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
